name: Skins help
description: The Skins plugin's Help mode entries (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Skins
entries.text: Every skin in one gallery. Tap one to preview it live, then Use skin to switch the scope you picked: the whole hub, this app, one screen or one plugin.

entries.title: Where
entries.text: Which level the buttons change: the whole hub, this app, one screen or one plugin. A smaller scope wins over a bigger one.

entries.title: Desktop or phone
entries.text: Shows the preview at desktop or phone width. Nothing is saved until you tap Use skin.

entries.title: Use skin
entries.text: Switches the picked scope to the skin you are previewing. Undo puts it back.

entries.title: Back to skin
entries.text: Drops every change made on top of the skin at this scope, so it shows as it ships. The skin stays.

entries.title: Restore to Default
entries.text: Puts this scope back to its default: no hub-wide skin, the app's saved look, or the screen / plugin following its parent. Undo puts it back.

entries.title: Undo
entries.text: Takes back the last Use, Back or Restore. Only one step is kept.

steps.say: Pick where to switch: the hub, this app, one screen or one plugin.
Tap a skin to preview it, on desktop or phone width.
Use skin switches it. Undo takes it back.
